verdict.rationale: Okta's first-party docs describe event hooks as outbound HTTPS REST calls to a URL you specify, sent when specified events occur in your org. That is the core webhook subscription mechanism this story asks for. The evidence is thin beyond that definition: it doesn't list which events are covered or describe how hooks are set up, verified or delivered. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that user lifecycle and authentication events are among the subscribable event types, details on hook setup, verification and delivery reliability, independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time delivery.
